message:
The `pj_param` function itself looks safe. The vulnerability description says "array lookup with wrong indices due to missing validation before accessing the array." Let me look at the projection files (PJ_*.c) for array indexing issues. This is likely a known CVE in proj.4. Let me check the `pj_init_ctx` and `pj_init_plus` code path, and look for array indexing in the projection setup functions.

Let me search for known vulnerable patterns - particularly in `PJ_*.c` files where parameters are used to index arrays.

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>grep -rn "\[.*\]" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4/src/PJ_*.c | grep -v "P->" | grep -v "P->" | grep -v "xy\[" | grep -v "lp\[" | grep -v "xyz\[" | grep -v "lpz\[" | head -50</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
